name: Self-evolving wavetable pad rack you can safely randomize: two formant-style wavetable oscillators (-1 and -2 octaves) through serial 12 dB low-pass and high-pass filters on one macro, an internal matrix where envelope 2 drives both wavetable positions and envelope 3 drives envelope 2's attack, plus an external slow triangle LFO that pushes the amp envelope times in opposite directions, with ADSR excluded from macro randomization
goal: Build a lush, gently moving pad as a macro rack. Oscillators: osc 1 and osc 2 on formant/voice-type wavetables, osc 1 at -1 octave and osc 2 at -2 octaves, sub on, volume about -12 dB, unison 'shimmer' mode with 4 voices. Filters: two 12 dB filters in serial (low-pass and high-pass) with about 2 dB and 1 dB drive and one shared frequency macro so raising it also trims lows, and one shared resonance macro kept low. Internal mod matrix: env 2 to osc 1 position 50 and to osc 2 position 75; LFO 1 to each position 15; env 2 to filter 1 frequency 10 and LFO 1 to it 3; env 3 to env 2 attack 100; LFO 1 to env 2 sustain 50; env 2 to filter 2 frequency -2; LFO 1 retrigger off, very slow. External LFO (triangle, low Hz) after the synth: filter frequency 50, amp attack -60, decay +30, sustain -40, release +40 (opposing directions for complexity), osc 1 warp 50, osc 1 fold 20, osc 2 effect 50. Macros: positions, warp/fold, osc 2 transpose, filter frequency, resonance, ADSR (amp + env 2 + env 3 together), mod rate (both LFOs), mod amount, LFO shape, shimmer amount. Add a limiter last. Exclude the ADSR macros from randomize, then randomize and store snapshots.

source.title: Step-by-Step Guide: Beautiful Wavetable Pads (Ableton Live 12)
source.transcript_note: Auto-generated YouTube Show transcript; values are as spoken and approximate where the speaker says 'about' or 'around'.

prerequisites: A wavetable synth with at least 3 envelopes, 1-2 LFOs, a mod matrix that can target envelope times, warp/fold oscillator effects and serial filters
A macro/rack system or parameter-mapping layer with snapshots and randomize
An external LFO/modulator device and a limiter

inputs.name: wavetables
inputs.description: Two soft formant/voice-like wavetables (original or free)

inputs.name: note_range
inputs.description: Pad register; oscillators sit at -1 and -2 octaves

constraints: Original synthesis recipe; not affiliated with any vendor named in the source. Recreate in browser/Web Audio (Polyrhythm Studio) or any hybrid synth with comparable modules; no presets, banks or samples copied.
Matrix and LFO amounts are the speaker's values on a 0-100 scale; treat them as relative depths when porting.
Keep LFO rates very low and resonance low: the video stresses that pads do not need rapid modulation. No pitch modulation is used, which suits Matt's preference for steady pitch.
The external LFO modulation is not saved inside a synth preset; store the whole rack with snapshots, or in Web Audio keep the LFO in the patch graph.
Excluding ADSR from randomize keeps the pad's duration/sustain character while timbre is explored.
Auto-generated YouTube Show transcript; values are as spoken and approximate where the speaker says 'about' or 'around'.

steps.action: Create a rack on a MIDI track and expose all 16 macros; insert the wavetable synth.
Osc 1: formant/voice wavetable at -1 octave; enable osc 2 with a darker formant wavetable at -2 octaves; enable the sub; set synth volume to about -12 dB; unison mode 'shimmer' with 4 voices.
Enable both filters as 12 dB types in serial (low-pass then high-pass), drive about 2 dB and 1 dB.
steps.expect: A warm band that can be thinned from below.

steps.action: Matrix: env 2 → osc 1 position 50, osc 2 position 75; LFO 1 → both positions 15; env 2 → filter 1 freq 10; LFO 1 → filter 1 freq 3; env 3 → env 2 attack 100; LFO 1 → env 2 sustain 50; env 2 → filter 2 freq -2. LFO 1: sine, retrigger off, slow.
steps.expect: Each note's timbre moves on its own and differs note to note.

steps.action: Map macros: osc 1 position, osc 1 warp, osc 1 fold, osc 2 position, osc 2 effect, osc 2 transpose, filter frequency (both filters on one knob), resonance (both), amp/env 2/env 3 ADSR, mod rate (LFO rate), mod amount, mod shape, shimmer amount.
steps.expect: All key controls on one page.

steps.action: Add an external LFO after the synth, set to triangle at a low Hz rate; map its rate/depth to the mod-rate/mod-amount macros. Map it to filter frequency (50), amp attack (-60), decay (+30), sustain (-40), release (+40), osc 1 warp (50), osc 1 fold (20), osc 2 effect (50).
steps.expect: Envelope times and wave shapes drift in opposing directions over time.

steps.action: Add a limiter last as a safety against level jumps.
Exclude the ADSR macros from randomization, press randomize until a pad you like appears, and save each as a snapshot; save the rack.
steps.expect: A bank of related, stable-length pad variations.

verification: Holding one chord for 30 s yields audible timbre motion without pitch change.
Randomizing macros never changes the amp ADSR values.
Raising the filter macro brightens the top and trims the low end at the same time.
